etsy.title: Rally Jump Poster, Funny Motorsport Sign, Co Driver Humor Wall Art, Racing Pit Sign Garage Decor
etsy.description:
A funny rally jump poster styled as a stage warning sign: JUMP, and the co-driver said "maybe".

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a garage, man cave, office, or on a rally fan's wall.

No team, series, or manufacturer marks: just generic rally humor.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: 'Rally jump' posters exist but are real-car illustrations of cars airborne over crests; none are sign-style or joke-led.
Physical jump prints in snippets were roughly $18 to $31 USD, but mixed with framed and digital versions, so not used as a price range.

searchPhrases: retro rally car wall art poster unframed garage
funny racing sign poster man cave garage
competitorNotes: Amazon rally prints are mostly watercolor real-car paintings sold unframed in 8x10 to 16x20, pitched for garage and man cave walls and as a gift for car enthusiasts.
Funny racing wall decor on Amazon is dominated by 8x12 metal tin signs (speed-limit and parking jokes); no co-driver or pace-note jokes surfaced.

research.notes: Primary keyword uses the printed word 'jump' with the indexed 'rally posters' family; 'motorsport sign' (indexed) is the secondary angle for the sign layout. 'rally sign' avoided per keyword file. No priceRange: snippet prices mixed framed, digital, and real-car prints.
